description.en: Evolves a character's avatar with the standard "sysmes-Avatar-00002" message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunEvolutionAvatarUseMsg.
Optional; whether to lock the avatar after evolving (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Evolve a character's avatar with the standard presentation
RunEvolutionAvatar("para_cp0008", "ck0033");
